var machine = getMachine((await listMachines())[0].id)
var opt = `#!/bin/bash
export PATH=$HOME/.local/usr/bin:$PATH
cd /tmp
log=/tmp/opt.log
: > $log
mk() {
  n=$1; f=$2; c=$3; l=$4
  ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -i /tmp/raw.gif -vf "fps=$f,split[a][b];[a]palettegen=max_colors=$c:stats_mode=diff[p];[b][p]paletteuse=dither=none:diff_mode=rectangle" -loop 0 /tmp/m_$n.gif
  s1=$(stat -c%s /tmp/m_$n.gif)
  if [ -n "$l" ]; then
    gifsicle -O2 --lossy=$l /tmp/m_$n.gif -o /tmp/g_$n.gif
  else
    gifsicle -O2 /tmp/m_$n.gif -o /tmp/g_$n.gif
  fi
  s2=$(stat -c%s /tmp/g_$n.gif)
  d=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 /tmp/g_$n.gif)
  fr=$(gifsicle --info /tmp/g_$n.gif 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  echo "$n fps=$f colors=$c lossy=\${l:-0} mid=$s1 final=$s2 dur=$d info=[$fr]" >> $log
}
mk a 5 96 ""
mk b 4 64 40
mk c 3 48 80
echo DONE >> $log
`
await machine.writeToFile({ text: opt, path: "/tmp/opt.sh", overwrite: true })
var r = await machine.exec({ command: "cd /tmp && nohup bash /tmp/opt.sh > /tmp/opt.out 2>&1 & echo started; sleep 45; cat /tmp/opt.log", timeout: 110 })

var fin = `#!/bin/bash
export PATH=$HOME/.local/usr/bin:$PATH
mkdir -p $HOME/Desktop
cp /tmp/g_d.gif $HOME/Desktop/promo.gif
mkdir -p /tmp/vd && rm -f /tmp/vd/*.png
i=0
for t in 1.2 2.7 4.1 5.5 6.9 8.3 9.7; do
  ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -ss $t -i $HOME/Desktop/promo.gif -frames:v 1 /tmp/vd/p\${i}_\$t.png
  i=$((i+1))
done
echo "=== frame hashes (should all differ) ==="
md5sum /tmp/vd/*.png
echo "=== final file ==="
ls -la $HOME/Desktop/promo.gif
stat -c '%s bytes' $HOME/Desktop/promo.gif
python3 - <<'PY'
from PIL import Image
im = Image.open('/home/user/Desktop/promo.gif')
n = getattr(im, 'n_frames', 1)
tot = 0
for f in range(n):
    im.seek(f)
    tot += im.info.get('duration', 0)
print('size:', im.size, 'frames:', n, 'duration_ms:', tot, 'duration_s:', tot/1000.0)
import os
b = os.path.getsize('/home/user/Desktop/promo.gif')
print('bytes:', b, 'MiB: %.4f' % (b/1048576), 'under_1MiB:', b < 1048576)
PY
`
